FeinwerkCampaignManager.SettingLowercaseTitle: Save campaign values in lower case
FeinwerkCampaignManager.SettingLowercaseHelp: Applies to the links of the Feinwerk Campaign Manager link builder; Matomo's tracking does not change. Matomo usually stores campaign names and keywords in lower case, so with this option the links use the same spelling and "Newsletter" and "newsletter" never become two values.

FeinwerkCampaignManager.ConnectorInstallerManualStep3: Activate the connector under Administration, Plugins.

FeinwerkCampaignManager.ConnectorInstallerWordPress: In Matomo for WordPress the Feinwerk Connector is installed as a WordPress plugin: open Matomo Analytics, Marketplace in WordPress and search for Feinwerk.
FeinwerkCampaignManager.UrlBuilderNote: Save links, use channel templates and see the numbers per campaign: in Feinwerk Campaign Manager.

FeinwerkCampaignManager.PromoCampaignsText: UTM builder and naming conventions for your team, so that campaigns arrive in Matomo cleanly.
FeinwerkCampaignManager.PromoCampaignsInstallText: The free plugin Feinwerk Campaign Manager builds clean campaign links right in Matomo and shows visits and conversions per campaign.
FeinwerkCampaignManager.PromoCampaignsOpenText: Feinwerk Campaign Manager is installed: create campaign links and see visits and conversions per campaign.
FeinwerkCampaignManager.PromoHostingText: Feinwerk runs your Matomo instance in German data centers, with updates, backups and monitoring, and the move is included.
FeinwerkCampaignManager.PromoCapiText: Feinwerk Conversions API sends orders and goals from Matomo server-side to Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, X and Microsoft Advertising, only with consent and without ad pixels on your website.
FeinwerkCampaignManager.PromoConnectorText: Exclusive Plugins for Matomo by Feinwerk, free, freemium and premium:
FeinwerkCampaignManager.PromoConnectorLink: Install the Feinwerk Connector from the Matomo Marketplace
FeinwerkCampaignManager.PromoSentinelText: The free plugin Feinwerk Sentinel watches your Matomo data around the clock and alerts you by email, Slack or Teams as soon as goals stop or tracking breaks.
FeinwerkCampaignManager.PlatformDisabled: The connection to Feinwerk Campaigns is switched off in this Matomo (platform = 0 in the configuration).
FeinwerkCampaignManager.PlatformIntro: With the connection, Feinwerk Campaign Manager uses your workspace in Feinwerk Campaigns: its naming convention, its campaigns, short links and QR codes. Your saved links and campaign details stay in this Matomo.
FeinwerkCampaignManager.PlatformWhatIsSent: When you connect, your browser sends Feinwerk Campaigns the address of this Matomo, your e-mail address (only to prefill sign-in or sign-up) and the names and addresses of your websites. There you sign in or create an account and confirm the connection for a workspace. Afterwards Matomo calls Feinwerk Campaigns only with the access key of the connection; no visitor data is sent.
FeinwerkCampaignManager.PlatformDisconnectConfirm: Disconnect this Matomo from Feinwerk Campaigns? Saved links and campaign details stay here.
FeinwerkCampaignManager.PlatformOpenTooltip: Opens the workspace in Feinwerk Campaigns; you sign in there.
FeinwerkCampaignManager.PlatformExpired: The trial has ended without a purchase. Short links and QR codes from Feinwerk Campaigns are not available; everything else works as before.
FeinwerkCampaignManager.PlatformLost: The connection no longer works: it was disconnected in Feinwerk Campaigns, or the person who confirmed it lost access. Please connect again.
FeinwerkCampaignManager.PlatformBlocked: Access to Feinwerk Campaigns is blocked for this organisation. Please contact Feinwerk support.
FeinwerkCampaignManager.PlatformWorkspaceEnded: The workspace in Feinwerk Campaigns has ended and can only be read. No new links can be created there.
FeinwerkCampaignManager.PlatformUnreachable: Feinwerk Campaigns cannot be reached right now. The connection stays; please try again later.
